speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with postmenopausal bleeding and an adnexal mass. To begin our evaluation, how long has the bleeding been occurring, and have you experienced any pain, weight loss, or urinary symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Hyperplasia with Atypia or Early Endometrial Carcinoma.

Based on your age and two months of postmenopausal bleeding, I need to evaluate the thickness of the uterine lining immediately. Please request an Endometrial_Biopsy and a Pelvic_Ultrasound to assess the adnexal mass and endometrial thickness.
